The other day, I found myself glued to the window watching the clouds roll in, wondering if I should be doing something more than just hoping for the best. I remembered a handy resource about tornado preparedness that I once came across. It’s full of practical tips that can really help make sense of a stormy day. 

So, I took a moment to check it out and ended up feeling a lot more prepared and a little less anxious. Sometimes, just knowing what to do makes all the difference, doesn’t it? 

What’s your go-to tip for staying calm when the skies turn gray? ☁️
